LESSON: LENGTH

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade six
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: MEASUREMENT Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learning Expe
Topic 2.1: Length
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 14

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Length, part of MEASUREMENT Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learning Expe in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade six MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: when measuring 1. Why do you measure lengths of different objects in day to day life?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Length together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: The learner reinforces speaking, listening skills and embrace teamwork as they

establish the relationship between centimetres and millimetres.

Values:
• Unity: The learner works collaboratively to determine the lengths in mm and cm in addition, subtraction, multiplication

and division and discuss the answers with peers.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Citizenship: The learner displays social cohesion as they work in groups to choose appropriate units to measure lengths of

different objects in the environment.

Links to other Learning Areas:
• Creative Arts: The learner sketches the circumference of a circle and measure radius and diameter of a circle.

Suggested Learning Resources:

● Metre rule, tactile metre rule, tactile tape measure, tape measure, metre stick,

place value apparatus with appropriate font and colour contrast , abacus, Taylor frames with plastic types or cubes and

cubarithm boards, reference materials in Braille and appropriate print, threads
